s1.syndrome_frame: Progressive breast mass with skin ulceration and underlying cystic-solid lesion
salient_findings: Palpable breast lump with progressive growth
Firm, immobile mass with indistinct borders
Loss of normal breast architecture on ultrasound
key_facts: 51-year-old woman
2-cm palpable right-breast lump in 2019
Progressive growth of the lump
Skin ulceration with straw-colored exudate by June 2021
Local pain but no systemic symptoms
No chronic medical history
Asymmetrically enlarged right breast
15×15 cm firm, immobile mass with indistinct borders
Erythematous, swollen, and dehiscent overlying skin
No axillary or clavicular lymphadenopathy
Mild anemia (hemoglobin 83 g/L)
Slightly low albumin
Normal blood counts and liver function tests
Loss of normal architecture on breast ultrasound
Mixed cystic and solid echoes on ultrasound
Large irregular cystic-solid lesion with internal fluid levels and tortuous vessels on CT and MRI

shortlist.label: Invasive ductal carcinoma
shortlist.why_kept: Progressive growth, skin ulceration, and cystic-solid lesion on imaging

shortlist.label: Inflammatory breast cancer
shortlist.why_kept: Rapid progression, skin erythema, and swelling

shortlist.label: Papillary carcinoma
shortlist.why_kept: Dilated ducts with broad papillary structures and moderately atypical nuclei on biopsy

shortlist.label: Encapsulated papillary carcinoma
shortlist.why_kept: Papillary structures and absence of myoepithelial markers on biopsy

shortlist.label: Phyllodes tumor
shortlist.why_kept: Large, firm, and immobile mass with cystic and solid components on imaging

raw.rationale: The presence of skin ulceration, erythema, swelling, and dehiscence, along with a large, firm, and immobile mass, are characteristic features of inflammatory breast cancer. The absence of systemic symptoms and the specific immunohistochemistry profile also support this diagnosis.

rejected.label: Invasive ductal carcinoma
rejected.why: While possible, the specific skin changes and lack of lymphadenopathy are more suggestive of inflammatory breast cancer

rejected.label: Papillary carcinoma
rejected.why: The presence of broad papillary structures is noted, but the clinical presentation and imaging findings are more consistent with inflammatory breast cancer

rejected.label: Encapsulated papillary carcinoma
rejected.why: The lack of a fibrous cystic capsule and the presence of fused papillary networks argue against this diagnosis

rejected.label: Phyllodes tumor
rejected.why: The clinical presentation and histological features, such as the absence of myoepithelial markers, do not support this diagnosis
